CustomField.description: Rich-text inline body used by the confirmation email Flow when no EmailTemplate DeveloperName is provided in Email Template Name (Confirmation). Provides an admin-editable fallback message without creating an EmailTemplate record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional inline email body used for the confirmation email when no Email Template Name (Confirmation) is set. Use this for a quick custom message without building a full EmailTemplate.
CustomField.label: Email Template Body (Confirmation)
